name: crush
description: Tool-output compressor (crush 2). Classifies every tool result and applies only transforms that passed a token, accuracy and edit-safety gate: grep/rg hits grouped by file (full-path headings, every line byte-exact), identical-line runs counted in words. File views and diffs are never changed. Pass-through on any doubt.
author: Jawz

commands.name: crush
commands.description: Report how many tokens crush has saved this session (estimated).
